limits: Recovery and ownership browser adapters are controlled fixtures with real components; no device passkey ceremony or real wallet signature was performed.
Indexed history browser checks use the local production build and actual public Envio/RPC reads. SDK telemetry/settings POST requests remained blocked by the harness.
The original user browser journal was not available to the independent verifier. Exact legacy payment nonce recovery is covered by regression fixtures, not asserted as an observed user session.
Historical recovery is bounded to 200 indexed shards and 200 blocks after execution for the exact payer/authorization nonce.
